name: sdd-speckit
description: Spec-Driven Development starter kit: Speckit phase commands, layered industry and stack templates, greenfield and brownfield onboarding, phase-matched subagents, and harness gates for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

TELEMETRY_ENABLED.title: OpenTelemetry usage monitoring
TELEMETRY_ENABLED.description: Emit local Claude Code usage metrics. Off unless you turn it on.

OTEL_EXPORTER.title: OTel metrics exporter
OTEL_EXPORTER.description: Exporter used when telemetry is on: console or otlp.

OTEL_ENDPOINT.title: OTLP endpoint
OTEL_ENDPOINT.description: Collector endpoint. Required only when the exporter is otlp.

PROJECT_MODE.title: Project mode
PROJECT_MODE.description: greenfield, brownfield or auto. Sets the default harness gate modes and the onboarding route.

INDUSTRY_PROFILE.title: Industry profile
INDUSTRY_PROFILE.description: Industry profile id (profiles/industries/): general-saas, healthcare, financial-services, public-sector or none.

STACK_PRESET.title: Tech stack profile
STACK_PRESET.description: Stack profile id (profiles/stacks/) whose fragments are composed into the templates.

PRIMARY_ASSISTANT.title: Primary AI assistant
PRIMARY_ASSISTANT.description: Speckit integration key: claude, copilot, droid, cursor-agent or generic. Use the installer's --assistant=both to also render the GitHub Copilot files, or --assistant=factory for Factory Droid.
